items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1968-03-03
items.q: Oh, yes, Satch is the greatest, man. That's my best friend.

ctx.x: Well, no, I wasn't belittling you, because I've known you for a good many years. I mean, I've known your technique and your ability and your records and so forth, and I've got a lot of them home, and I play them too. But I have to admit, and I think you will too, that as far as publicity goes, I think Satch has a little more than you have.
Oh, yes, Satch is the greatest, man. That's my best friend.

I haven't seen him in years. I had him on interviews some years ago when he had Tee Garden with him and Barrett Deems and a lot of the other boys were with him at the time. They were playing over in San Francisco, and we had him on the air, and he was a kick to talk to.

items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: I heard, when I was small also, I heard Louis Armstrong's but it was in Perez.

ctx.x: Buddy Petit. Yeah, I heard all that. I heard, when I was small also, I heard Louis Armstrong's but it was in Perez.
